summary: Pilot baseline established. Applied session-date fix (prepend 'Session date: {date}' in ingest.py). LoCoMo (1 conv, 2 probes): our-way=100%/100%F1, search=0%, cold=0%. LongMemEval (2 conv, 4 probes): our-way=100%/81.2%F1, search=0%, cold=0%. Search arm shows 0% across both benchmarks: /search endpoint returns only probe stub nodes (kind=task), no ingested session notes appear in search results despite being visible via /task/context. This is a separate bug from the prior stub-filter fix (which filtered out stubs that DID appear in results). Notes are ingested correctly (confirmed by our-way arm hitting them via DAG edges) but do not appear in /search queries — likely a workspace-scoped indexing gap in the search endpoint.
